job: Two drives have failed in the data hall: one high up in row A at U40 and one low down in row B at U10. Pull both sled caddies and bring the last one out to the staging bench outside the hall.
understood_as: Pull the failed drive sleds from bay A U40 and bay B U10 in the data hall, and carry the last one pulled out of the hall to the staging bench.
steps: Go to row A and pull the drive sled from U40 by its handle.
Go to row B and pull the drive sled from U10 by its handle.
Carry the U10 sled out of the hall to the staging bench.

demos.why: Shows how the hand releases the latch and draws the sled straight out of the bay without twisting it.
Shows how firmly to hold the sled handle so the drive does not slip out or the handle get bent.

questions: What should happen to the first sled pulled (row A, U40)? As written only the last one goes to the staging bench, so the plan leaves the U40 sled with the robot or set down nearby. Should it also be carried out?
The staging bench has not been located as an anchor, so the plan only takes the sled out of the hall. If it must be placed on the bench itself, please have the bench scanned or marked.

Do these sleds have a latch or lever that has to be released before pulling? The planner can only grasp and pull. If there is a release, please show it in the 'pull drive sled' demonstration or tell us how it works.
You didn't mention installing replacement drives, so the plan only removes the failed ones. Is that right?
